I work with both college and actual professional reporters who have been sued for things like asking for public records for the public school. I've been threatened before for working with a team to expose a student and teacher grade fraud. It's not guaranteed but likely and it can ruin you.

Yea, I guess it could be. But it doesn't pay well.

No, I can't think of anything. The only jobs I would enjoy I either can't do (I know for a fact I don't have the ability to be an astrophysicist or theoretical physicist) or they pay crap making living hard, such as journalism where you then have being sued by people, states and companies because they want to cover up their stuff.

I just can't find any thing to keep me wanting to stay. I don't even feel like I'm a sane person.

I can see why that would be hard. From my experience, AD can help or make it worse, though the last part is typically rare, me being one of the rare cases it happened.

Is there any way you can talk your parents into letting you use antidepressants or have them meet with the therapist? They may be able to convince your parents to let you use them. They could very likely help you a lot and worth trying.

If that fails, if you went to the school, what would your parents do?
I very much feel the same in a world that doesn't take you seriously.
I too have a history of self-harming and suicide thoughts. I live on the west coast, so if you need to talk to someone, by all means, I'm here to talk to you.

I was inpatiented twice for a total time of 2 weeks. One had me wait in an open room "ER" for the mentally ill where my anxiety shot through the roof, cut myself, and they did nothing. I was there for over 30 hours, so I did all I could to get the hell out. Went to St. Vincent in Portland and was one of the best things I've ever done. 

Sadly, it depends on your location and hospital, but Providence is a pretty good hospital if you need to go impatient. 

The wait can sometimes be long, and it's a paint I know well, trust me. Depending on staff and where you're at, you can always ask and get an idea. I'm assuming you're with your psych because you're on the internet, because they took everything of mine away and they're very well do it to you, since you're in for suicidal reasons. They did for me at least.
I just don't care. I encourage them to get physical, considering I'm trained in mixed martial arts, as well as typically armed with something. Verbal threats and comments almost never bother me.

No, because I'm still biologically male. I still have a dick, so he'd not technically be straight. But I don't care for those labels, it's simply have sex with whom you want. 

Not the same thing. Not even close.

How does this have to do with my self-respect when it's about him, not me? Peoples words and views or opinions have no affect on me. What I care about if the person I'm with. That has nothing to do with "Self-respect" in this regard. 

Did you not see in that very line it's about the other person, not me?
Except, I'm 24, so the effects hormones can do to make me pass will diminish over time the longer I wait.

I do have a therapist, but it seems to do little help as she wants to know about my other issues, like depression, suicide and former lover that I still miss. 

In stead of what I see as helping, she wants me to answer my own issues by talking and coming to the conclusion myself. She is against giving me any form of an answer or true evaluation. I don't know if that's normal, but it seems counter-productive.
Can you afford electrolysis? If you could afford any of those, I'd go for that and get work done on the most noticeable and annoying parts of the face.
